reason: A more directly and testably links diffusion-controlled intermetallic precipitation/coarsening and matrix depletion to both corrosion and oxidation performance, with a clear as-processed baseline and falsification criterion; it is also better aligned with the cited evidence for metastable phase formation and Ti-rich passivation. Its proposed 800–1200 °C range may be unrealistic for many Mg-rich alloys and requires refinement, but B’s claim that a continuous Mg-rich intermetallic grain-boundary network protects against oxygen ingress is less physically grounded and unsupported.
